summary: Allows protected plugin-toolchain publication to safely reuse an unchanged immutable Helm chart when only archive timestamps or ownership metadata differ.
userImpact: Plugin installation toolchain publication can complete when an existing chart version has the same files, permissions, links, and contents as the release source.
A real chart payload, permission, link, or path change under an existing immutable version still fails the release closed.
security: The canonical comparison verifies tar checksums, rejects unsafe or duplicate paths and unsupported entry types, and includes file contents, executable modes, link targets, and security-relevant extended attributes.
Only archive timestamps and ownership metadata are excluded because they do not change the deployed chart payload.
documentation: The generated release notes explain that immutable chart reuse is based on a fail-closed canonical payload comparison.
rollback: Revert the release workflow change to restore byte-for-byte archive comparison; already published chart artifacts remain immutable.
validation: Canonical chart archive unit tests covering metadata-only changes, file contents, executable modes, added paths, unsafe paths, and malformed tar headers
Protected plugin-toolchain release policy checks and comparison against the chart artifact from the failed v0.16.0 toolchain run
